senses.gloss: m. pl. (perh. from their shape, v. preced.) Nodiin, name of a superior variety of olives.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:2:3">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ</cite> <he>זיתי נ׳</he> (not <cite ref="G00430"><he>זית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:2:3">Ib.</cite> <he>דרכן ליבחן בנ׳</he> (not <he>כנ׳</he>) they are usually examined to see whether there are Nodiin among them.
